releaseNotesHtml:
Security

  • bind the in-app bridge-server to the localhost-only Loopback Interface instead of all interfaces (98e9a46)

Features

  • add a keyboard shortcut to select/deselect all entries in the kv entries browser table (c2adc2d)

Bug Fixes

  • check if cached updates are still available before starting the download process (8448c90)

Enhancements

  • improve watched keys save performance by eliminating an unnecessary SELECT statement that runs on every save (f1dbbac)

Maintenance

  • upgrade Electron from v43 to v44, therefore Node v24.20.0 and Chromium to v152.0.7977.76 (87b7a71)

User Interface Changes

  • re-design the "atomic delete" option in "Delete Selected Kv Entries" alert dialog (5cd7ae6)

Full Changelog: v1.31.0...v1.32.0
